The graduate collection has moved. Undergraduate and graduate courses now sit
together in one inventory, so you are being redirected to the **graduate
records** in the [Course Library](courses.qmd).

If you are not redirected, open the [Course
Library](courses.qmd) and choose the **Graduate** category.
